utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — could you handle organizing the tool drop-off list? I’ll be a bit late, but I’ll catch up and help wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll organize the tool drop-off list and keep things moving until you get here. Just let me know when you arrive, and I’ll fill you in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to confirm what repairs are most needed first, so I can help in the right way. Could you tell me what items or tasks you want me to focus on?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with the front gate, the leaky sink, and any broken lights. If you can check those first, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive. What do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Cleo. I think we still need a few boxes of nails and some screwdrivers, but I might be forgetting something.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep an eye out for nails and screwdrivers, and I’ll ask around in case anything else turns up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet, but I’m curious. What are they hoping to fix during the drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet, but I’d guess the usual things—appliances, small plumbing issues, maybe a few broken fixtures. I just hope they’ve got enough people and tools for it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that makes sense. If they’ve got enough hands, it could help a lot of people around here.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell, are we still on for the repair drive today? I want to make sure I bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think so, but I’m not totally sure yet—I heard it’s still on. Let me check and I’ll let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell. Just let me know when you confirm, and I’ll bring my toolkit if it’s on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is still on for this weekend, and folks are dropping off tools and supplies down by the community center. Sounds like they’re hoping to get a lot done before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, that sounds about right — I can swing by and drop off a few tools myself. Hope they get a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Gus — every little bit helps. I’ll keep my ears open in case they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m definitely spreading the word about the repair drive—everyone on the block should hear about it. If you want, I can help line up a few more neighbors to join in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great, Quinn. I can help keep track of who’s interested and where everyone’s meeting.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Opal—I'll start asking around and send people your way as they say yes. Let’s make this repair drive really count for the block.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just checking—you're definitely in for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, I’m definitely in for the repair drive. Just tell me where you need me and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo — I’m keeping the repair drive on track and making sure everyone who needs help gets matched up. What’s the first thing you want to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great—let’s start with the most urgent repairs and match folks up there first. I’ll skim the list and see who can help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Bo — let’s flag the most urgent fixes first, and I’ll help pair each one with whoever’s available. Send me the list when you’ve skimmed it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive to folks around the neighborhood and keep it on the radar.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate that. Let’s keep it simple and see who needs help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and see who might need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m glad we’re doing it, though I’ll admit I’m a bit fuzzy on the details right now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, me too. I think we’re just gathering anything broken or worn out folks want fixed, and then we’ll sort it from there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds right to me. I can help collect things, if you want—I just might need a reminder where to bring them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help link folks up for the repair drive—do you want me to spread the word or help organize who’s bringing what?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, please spread the word. If you can also help match people with what they can bring, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word and help pair people with supplies or tools they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. If you want, I can start by inviting the folks on Maple and Pine.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that’d be great — Maple and Pine are a solid start. I’ll swing by late and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll head over there now and let them know. See you later, and thanks for pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive—sounds helpful. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d appreciate help sorting donations and keeping things organized. If you’re free Saturday morning, I can give you a clear list when you stop by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Saturday morning works for me. I’ll stop by and help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can help coordinate around the school schedule. What time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I’m still nailing down the exact time, but I’ll let you know as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, just keep me posted and I’ll work around it once you know the time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I’m happy to help spread the word and connect people up for the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — could you help repeat the date, time, and what items people can bring? I’d really appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — I’ll spread the word! Just send me the date, time, and a list of items people can bring, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a hand for the repair drive—I've got a few tools I can bring by. Just tell me what you need most.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s really kind, Gus. I’m trying to figure out what we’ll need first so we don’t end up hauling the wrong things.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—once you know the top jobs, I can bring the right tools and save us both some trips.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m pretty sure the repair drive is set up over by the community center, near the side lot. If you want, I can double-check the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal—that would be great. I’ll head over to the community center side lot and keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll go check the exact spot and let you know if it’s by the side lot entrance or farther along the fence.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still on for the repair drive today? I can bring the tools if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I think so — can you remind me what time you were planning to come by? I want to make sure we have everything we need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I was planning to come by around 2 PM. I’ll bring the tools and check if anything else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam—could you help me sort the donated tools and count what we’ve got?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course—I can do that. I’ll sort the tools and count everything we have.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think it’s coming up soon, but I’m a bit fuzzy on the details. Have you heard where they’re collecting stuff?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Not yet—I was hoping you’d know! I’ve only heard it’s for fixing up old bikes and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, are we definitely still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, we’re still on for today — I’ve been hearing a few folks say they can help out. I’ll pass along any updates if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — can you let me know if the time or meeting spot changes?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice turnout. I’m heading out for errands anyway—I'll swing by and see if they need anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I appreciate you checking in and helping out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course—happy to help. I’ll stop by and let you know if they need more hands or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve forgotten the details, but I’m happy to help out if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren. Can you help with the load-up later today?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can help with the load-up later today. Just remind me what time you want me there.
